inheritedFindings.claim: The drift check reads only the static checked-in profile via getModelPricingProfile, so a per-model env price override (the same override that lib/modelPricing.ts resolveModelPricing honours at cost-resolution time) can raise the effective input/output rate far above the pinned 0.2/1.2 while the preregistration still reports no drift and keeps the frozen 24,916 microUSD per-request ceiling.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: node --import tsx -e "process.env.CHAT_MODEL_GPT_5_6_LUNA_INPUT_USD_PER_MILLION='99'; const c=await import('./lib/promptRefinerExecutionContract.ts'); const p=await import('./lib/modelPricing.ts'); const m=await import('./lib/models.ts'); console.log(c.promptRefinerExecutionContractProblems(), p.resolveModelPricing(m.getModel('gpt-5-6-luna')).inputUsdPerMillionTokens, c.PROMPT_REFINER_PER_REQUEST_COST_CEILING_MICRO_USD)" -- expected today: [] alongside an effective rate of 99 and an unchanged 24916 ceiling; a contract that refuses this drift would list a problem instead (or the boundary that only checked-in facts are frozen would be stated in lib/promptRefinerExecutionContract.ts and docs/policy/prompt-refiner-observability.md, so the future reservation authority must re-verify the resolved rate before dispatch).

changeSummary: 종결 exchange의 effective pricing drift finding을 후속 코드로 닫는다. 비용·예약 경로와 같은 resolveModelPricing()으로 input/output effective rate를 exact pin과 비교하고 환경 override 또는 runtime row drift를 dispatch 전 execution_contract_mismatch로 거절한다. 기존 on_hold 기록, provider/API/model 호출, runtime authority/adapter와 flag 상태는 변경하지 않는다.
